start: Signed in as the owner; member page; the member shows a workout code on their phone ("Show my workouts to the desk") and has checked in on those days

steps.action: In the "Training pattern" card tap "Check workout code"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Check workout code"
"For the workout offer. The member opens “Show my workouts to the desk” in the app. Type the code from their phone."
Box "Workout code"; button "Check" greyed while empty
must_not: The button missing on a member with a plan

steps.action: Type the code and tap "Check"
user_sees: A bold line saying how many workout days count
"Code made on <day>."
A list of days, each "✓ Checked in at the desk" (or on the app, at the entry machine, imported) or "No check-in: does not count"
must_not: A day counted without a check-in
Another member's code accepted for this member

steps.action: Tap "Give extra days"
user_sees: The sheet "Freeze / extra days" opens on "Gift – Extra days" with 3 days
must_not: Days added before the owner confirms
The days put on a plan that is not the one ending last

start: Signed in as the owner; "Check workout code" sheet open

steps.action: Type a wrong or half code and tap "Check"
user_sees: A red line under the box saying what is wrong with the code
No list of days
must_not: A crash on odd letters
A wrong code shown as zero days that count

steps.action: Type a code that is many days old
user_sees: The result, plus "It is more than <n> days old: ask for a new code to see the newest workouts."
must_not: An old code shown as fresh

steps.action: Check a good code for a member with no check-in on any of the days
user_sees: Every day reads "No check-in: does not count"
No "Give extra days" button and no owner line
must_not: A reward offered for days with no check-in

start: Signed in as the owner; "Check workout code" sheet showing a result

steps.action: Change one letter of the code
user_sees: The result goes away until "Check" is tapped again
must_not: The old result left under a new code

steps.action: Tap "Close", open the sheet again
user_sees: An empty box; nothing is remembered
must_not: The last member's code or result shown on another member

steps.action: Check the same code a second time
user_sees: The same result again
must_not: A second reward given for the same code with nothing saying it was used before

start: Signed in as the owner; "Check workout code" sheet with a good code

steps.action: Read everything the result shows
user_sees: Only days, and for each day whether the member checked in
must_not: Exercises, weights, sets, body weight or photos shown at the desk
Days of another member
